name: Fold Text
description: Text that unfolds in 3D from a hinge edge, split by character, word or line, with crease shading, three fold styles, several triggers, and an optional cursor-driven refold.
contents: Inline text split into per-char, per-word or per-line animated pieces
Screen-reader-only copy of the text, animated copy hidden from assistive tech
behavior: Each piece rotates from a folded angle to flat while fading in, staggered across the text
Crease shading overlay darkens pieces while they are folded
Trigger can be on mount, on scroll into view, on mouse enter, or looping with a fold-back between cycles
With hoverRefold, pieces near the pointer tilt back with a smooth falloff and relax when it leaves
Reduced motion removes rotation and shading and shortens the fade
editableByProps: Text and split mode (char, word, line with newlines)
Hinge edge, fold angle, perspective, crease shading strength
Pointer refold on or off, radius and angle
Font size, weight, color, extra classes and inline style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change scroll trigger start position or make it replay
needsCodeEdit.where: ScrollTrigger.create call with start 'top 82%' and once: true

needsCodeEdit.change: Change hinge shading colors or gradient
needsCodeEdit.where: shadeClass entries in the HINGES constant

needsCodeEdit.change: Change blinds slat timing or split

needsCodeEdit.where: lift constant inside the layout effect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change letter spacing or line height
needsCodeEdit.where: root span className with leading-[0.95] and tracking-[-0.04em]

fixed: Requires gsap and its ScrollTrigger plugin, registered globally on import
Pointer refold listens on window and the document element while hoverRefold is true
Flip style always rotates 180 degrees and ignores foldAngle
Hover trigger starts folded and only plays once per mouse enter on the text
Loop repeats forever with a fixed 0.35s repeat delay
Unknown hinge or foldStyle values fall back to top and paper
Default 80px font size is large, so set fontSize smaller for mobile screens (360px) to avoid wrapping or clipping
Hover trigger and pointer refold need a mouse, touch devices get no equivalent for hover trigger

options.look: Each piece hinges open like a folded paper flap from the chosen edge with crease shading
options.useWhen: Hero headline that should unfold on page load

options.look: Each piece splits into two slats that open in sequence like window blinds
options.useWhen: Section title on a scroll reveal that needs a more mechanical feel

options.look: Each piece flips a full 180 degrees around its center while lifting toward the viewer
options.useWhen: Short playful tagline or looping rotating word in a banner
